facts.label: Cascante
facts.text: Finds at places such as Funes and Cascante show that the Romans made wine on an industrial scale between the 1st and 5th centuries AD.

facts.label: Sierra de Urbasa
facts.text: With Andía, it filters the Atlantic air before it reaches Tierra Estella.

facts.label: Ribera Baja
facts.text: Ribera Baja has the most arid climate of all.

facts.label: The Ega
facts.text: In Tierra Estella the rocks are mostly marls with layers of sandstone, plus river terraces along the Ega and the Odrón.
